description: Test file for the LRUStriped cache implementation in the Mattermost project, including unit tests for bucket size, key distribution, hashing, and get/set operations.

methods.name: makeLRUPredictableTestData
methods.description: Generates predictable key-value string pairs for testing.

methods.name: TestNewLRUStriped
methods.description: Tests creation of a new striped LRU cache with specific bucket count and size.

methods.name: TestLRUStripedKeyDistribution
methods.description: Verifies key distribution across buckets in the striped cache.

methods.name: TestLRUStriped_Size
methods.description: Checks total size calculation of the cache buckets.

methods.name: TestLRUStriped_Get
methods.description: Tests get and set operations on the cache.

methods.name: BenchmarkSum64
methods.description: Benchmarks hashing functions (maphash and xxhash) with different string cases.
